Triangulum: the first galaxy, and the first tier the quasar holds together. The new verb is §9aim§r.

§5§lRUN§r Each cycle: bursts on the rail and no fluid at all (GRB stability alone holds a galaxy), for§9 600 L Ergomatter × Y × r × min(β, 1.5):§r Y is the cycle's mean field yield, r is 1 while the cycle's EU is paid (there is no upkeep), and β the bursts delivered ÷ the 1.5 Bu/t (1.5e13 EU/t, 15 trillion) demand.
- Like every tier from T2, it also makes §9Raw Star Matter§r: 350,000 L an Eye-minute × p × Y × r (N × 50,000 L at tier N; a quarter in planets mode).

§5§lTHE §lGAUGES§r
- §9P§r, pressure: bursts heat it at 3 × (β - 1) a second; Space trims cool it (-2 a unit, up to 10 a second). Aim for about§9 1.5 × the demand§r on average and send the surplus to a crown. The standard rig's J1 sends the Eye everything while P is low and nothing while it is high; its out 1 limit (7.5 Bu/t, 7.5e13 EU/t, per parallel) stops a big quasar flooding the Eye.
- §9W§r, the warp of the tilted rail: it drifts 1.5 a second in the precession sense. Aim the bursts between the high and low banks: W moves by 6 × (low - high).
- §9Minor mergers§r (every 15-30 min, a 15 s warning with the sign) push W ±12 a second for 5 s, then flip the precession.

§5§lDIRECTIVES§r The 4 plinth d sockets take Directive Hatches (Field, Events, Galaxy Transition) and a Burst Control Hatch in Begin mode; a Slots hatch can go in a Sensor socket. Each code adds its bits:
- Field: [1] P > +w Space trim, [2] P < -w more bursts, [4] W > +w aim high, [8] W < -w aim low.
- Events: [1] Λ > +w more to the halo, [2] Λ < -w less to the halo, [4] a countdown is running, [8] its sign is minus.
- Slots: [1] a slot is idle, [2] a companion's upkeep is short, [4] a planet run lost parallels, [8] link test fire wanted.

The Galaxy panel (the GUI's galaxy button) sets the mode and Begins. The terminal shows the bursts, β against the demand, W and the event countdown.

§2§lDONE §lWHEN§r you have 1,000 L of Ergomatter.
